column1: # Curated marker-classification mapping for the TxResBench method catalogue.
# One row (system,id) -> marker group + unit family + canonical unit.
#   system        : LOINC | HGNC | UNIPROT | HMDB | MIRBASE | OTHER
#   id            : the standard id exactly as declared (matched case-insensitively)
#   group         : one of the seven board groups (ctdna, counts, ldh, tumour-markers,
#   canonical_unit: the family's canonical unit string ("" when unknown/unitless)
# A (system,id) with no row maps to group "other" and a name-derived unit family.
# This is the hand-confirmed v1 mapping (OWNER-3: owner review at first real generation);
